| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c926fe39-cceb-4080-b26b-2e4222f135aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A gas pump at a gas station in Allagash, Maine on October 14, 2026. Photo by CHARLY TRIBALLEAU / AFP via Getty Images.
The state of Maine shattered another statewide record for heating oil prices this week. [On October 29](https://substack.com/redirect/247806ca-ada9-454b-8b90-d0716e6255a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Department of Energy Resources (DOER)'s weekly survey showed average statewide heating fuel prices rising to $6.05 per gallon as of October 26. This broke the previous record average statewide prices of $6.04 set on October 22, and $6.02 per gallon on September 21.
The record-shattering heating prices are taking their toll on Mainers ahead of the midterm elections on November 3. Roughly half of Mainers rely on heating oil as their principal energy source in winter--compared with just 3% nationwide--meaning Mainers face an increase of thousands of dollars in heating. The heating oil price hikes are directly affected by the war in Iran and closure of the strait of Hormuz, which handles roughly [20% to 25%](https://substack.com/redirect/cfed2c84-9d51-4c08-8612-b9b43f9a9d6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the world's seaborne oil and petroleum product flow. Sen. Susan Collins voted to extend U.S. military operations in Iran five times since February 2026.
Canvassers across the state are hearing that heating oil is a top issue for Maine voters in the Senate race. Azalea Cormier, who lives in Buckfield, told Drop Site she'd "knocked on over 1,000 doors this election cycle" as an Independent candidate for Maine's House of Representatives in a deep red district. She is also supporting Troy Jackson's campaign, and said "heating oil and gas is on everyone's mind."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcHNpdGVuZXdzLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.2D7bxO8KyYuREFS7dp9i656Cu5Z0Req3pXNMAFEl0Mg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=222803655)
"I seldom have conversations with people where either heat or transportation costs don't come up," Cormier said. "Lots of homes in my area in Western Maine have windowsills missing, trim falling off, siding gone or rotting. Many of the homes were built in the mid-1900s and have pretty noticeable degrees of damage. With the cold winter climate, and year-round moisture, these issues compound. The house gets more drafty in the winter, and it means an increased heating oil cost."
Cormier says it is typical for elderly folks living on fixed incomes in these historic farmhouses to insulate the kitchen and living room to save on heating costs, but she hasn't seen that happening this year in her community. She believes this means the homeowners are trying to avoid heating altogether in an "attempt to moderate their budgets."
Laurie Ellen Hudson, a 70-year-old widow living in the Western Maine town of Paris, told Drop Site her recent relocation to a "new house with oil heat" has been devastating to her finances. "I still don't have a woodstove hooked up or firewood, which I'm used to doing, so I'm relying on oil heat. I have less than 100 gallons in my tank. It cost 80% more than usual," Hudson said. "I don't know when my heat will run out and I don't have any other options."
Hudson is hoping "some money comes down the pipe" from the government to help cover her costs. She is currently borrowing money from a friend she described as "not well off and older" to cover her heating oil bills. Past that, she has no viable plans to pay for heating.
Another homeowner in Central Maine who shared their bills with Drop Site paid [$6.11 per gallon](https://substack.com/redirect/247806ca-ada9-454b-8b90-d0716e6255a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The receipts, almost exactly a year apart for an identical purchase, show an increase of 121% to refill a 215-gallon heating oil tank. An average Maine homeowner fills their tank at least four to five times a winter, translating to a cost of $5,120 to $6,400, an increase of $3,000-$4,000, during a [dire affordability crisis.](https://substack.com/redirect/7eaa0288-e02c-4401-9bb3-6f6eec1b01cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Union members and community volunteers with the Maine AFL-CIO have knocked on over 35,000 doors and had over 10,000 conversations with Maine voters since Troy Jackson became the democratic nominee.
"Heating oil costs and the general cost of living are the top concerns our union canvassers are hearing from voters at their doors," Andy O'Brien, the Maine AFL-CIO Communications Director told Drop Site. "Maine is the most dependent on heating oil of any state in the nation so when prices spike over $6 a gallon, that really makes a serious dent in household budgets, especially for elderly folks on fixed incomes. Many Mainers are barely getting by in this economy and simply can't afford to pay[ another $800](https://substack.com/redirect/c897b731-7938-4ddd-9b41-4e4b7eabe56e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to fill their tanks."
Aurora Green, a labor organizer and president of the Maine Graduate Student Workers Union, told Drop Site she has knocked on doors across the state from the Northern Maine town of East Millinocket to the affluent Southern Maine town of Kennebunk with Maine's labor movement.
"I keep hearing the same thing: people cannot keep up with the rising costs of heating oil and gasoline, and Mainers are becoming desperate," Green said. "My neighbors have described hazardous ways which they plan on heating their homes because they simply cannot afford heating oil. One person I canvassed told me that they paid over $1,000 last week to fill their tank."
While canvassing, Green said many people "understand the ongoing conflict in Iran has directly led to rising oil and gasoline prices." O'Brien agreed, telling Drop Site it's "no mystery" why heating oil costs have been rising exponentially, citing Susan Collins' role in allowing President Trump to attack Iran without planning for the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.
Of the 14 times Democrats forced the Senate to vote on Iran war powers measures since the conflict began in February, Collins[ voted five times](https://substack.com/redirect/7c7d4cae-6b91-47d4-a989-a152764edae3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against failed resolutions. She said after the first vote on March 4 that the move "[would send the wrong message to Iran and to our troops."](https://substack.com/redirect/2c1cd9ee-043e-49e4-a4df-52758286ac23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) The high cost of heating oil has been directly linked to blockages of the Strait of Hormuz following the U.S.-Israel initiation of war with Iran in February.
Jackson has jumped at the opportunity to attack Collins's role in increasing heating oil prices by backing Trump's war. Earlier this week, when Collins released a controversial attack ad through her surrogate Bill Green saying, "we're not talking about buying a cord of wood here, we're sending someone to the U.S. senate," Jackson quickly pivoted the conversation to heating oil prices.
"Senator Collins, I think you are a little out of touch. This is about a cord of wood--and about Mainers struggling to afford to heat their homes this winter. I know what it's like to run out of fuel. I've lived that struggle," [Jackson's campaign posted in response on Twitter](https://substack.com/redirect/f3df6583-f63f-492c-ae49-36c4ec08394c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). "That's the experience I'll take to the U.S. Senate. And I'll use it to fight for working people."

clean_body: The Iran War is driving Maine heating oil prices through the roof, leaving Mainers in dire straits days ahead of the U.S. Senate election. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more The Iran War is driving Maine heating oil prices through the roof, leaving Mainers in dire straits days ahead of the U.S. Senate election. | | | Oct 30| | | ∙| | Guest post ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- A gas pump at a gas station in Allagash, Maine on October 14, 2026. Photo by CHARLY TRIBALLEAU / AFP via Getty Images. The state of Maine shattered another statewide record for heating oil prices this week. , the Department of Energy Resources (DOER)'s weekly survey showed average statewide heating fuel prices rising to $6.05 per gallon as of October 26. This broke the previous record average statewide prices of $6.04 set on October 22, and $6.02 per gallon on September 21. The record-shattering heating prices are taking their toll on Mainers ahead of the midterm elections on November 3. Roughly half of Mainers rely on heating oil as their principal energy source in winter--compared with just 3% nationwide--meaning Mainers face an increase of thousands of dollars in heating. The heating oil price hikes are directly affected by the war in Iran and closure of the strait of Hormuz, which handles roughly of the world's seaborne oil and petroleum product flow. Sen. Susan Collins voted to extend U.S. military operations in Iran five times since February 2026. Canvassers across the state are hearing that heating oil is a top issue for Maine voters in the Senate race. Azalea Cormier, who lives in Buckfield, told Drop Site she'd "knocked on over 1,000 doors this election cycle" as an Independent candidate for Maine's House of Representatives in a deep red district. She is also supporting Troy Jackson's campaign, and said "heating oil and gas is on everyone's mind." "I seldom have conversations with people where either heat or transportation costs don't come up," Cormier said. "Lots of homes in my area in Western Maine have windowsills missing, trim falling off, siding gone or rotting. Many of the homes were built in the mid-1900s and have pretty noticeable degrees of damage. With the cold winter climate, and year-round moisture, these issues compound. The house gets more drafty in the winter, and it means an increased heating oil cost." Cormier says it is typical for elderly folks living on fixed incomes in these historic farmhouses to insulate the kitchen and living room to save on heating costs, but she hasn't seen that happening this year in her community. She believes this means the homeowners are trying to avoid heating altogether in an "attempt to moderate their budgets." Laurie Ellen Hudson, a 70-year-old widow living in the Western Maine town of Paris, told Drop Site her recent relocation to a "new house with oil heat" has been devastating to her finances. "I still don't have a woodstove hooked up or firewood, which I'm used to doing, so I'm relying on oil heat. I have less than 100 gallons in my tank. It cost 80% more than usual," Hudson said. "I don't know when my heat will run out and I don't have any other options." Hudson is hoping "some money comes down the pipe" from the government to help cover her costs. She is currently borrowing money from a friend she described as "not well off and older" to cover her heating oil bills. Past that, she has no viable plans to pay for heating. Another homeowner in Central Maine who shared their bills with Drop Site paid . The receipts, almost exactly a year apart for an identical purchase, show an increase of 121% to refill a 215-gallon heating oil tank. An average Maine homeowner fills their tank at least four to five times a winter, translating to a cost of $5,120 to $6,400, an increase of $3,000-$4,000, during a Union members and community volunteers with the Maine AFL-CIO have knocked on over 35,000 doors and had over 10,000 conversations with Maine voters since Troy Jackson became the democratic nominee. "Heating oil costs and the general cost of living are the top concerns our union canvassers are hearing from voters at their doors," Andy O'Brien, the Maine AFL-CIO Communications Director told Drop Site. "Maine is the most dependent on heating oil of any state in the nation so when prices spike over $6 a gallon, that really makes a serious dent in household budgets, especially for elderly folks on fixed incomes. Many Mainers are barely getting by in this economy and simply can't afford to pay to fill their tanks." Aurora Green, a labor organizer and president of the Maine Graduate Student Workers Union, told Drop Site she has knocked on doors across the state from the Northern Maine town of East Millinocket to the affluent Southern Maine town of Kennebunk with Maine's labor movement. "I keep hearing the same thing: people cannot keep up with the rising costs of heating oil and gasoline, and Mainers are becoming desperate," Green said. "My neighbors have described hazardous ways which they plan on heating their homes because they simply cannot afford heating oil. One person I canvassed told me that they paid over $1,000 last week to fill their tank." While canvassing, Green said many people "understand the ongoing conflict in Iran has directly led to rising oil and gasoline prices." O'Brien agreed, telling Drop Site it's "no mystery" why heating oil costs have been rising exponentially, citing Susan Collins' role in allowing President Trump to attack Iran without planning for the closure of the Strait of Hormuz. Of the 14 times Democrats forced the Senate to vote on Iran war powers measures since the conflict began in February, Collins against failed resolutions. She said after the first vote on March 4 that the move " The high cost of heating oil has been directly linked to blockages of the Strait of Hormuz following the U.S.-Israel initiation of war with Iran in February. Jackson has jumped at the opportunity to attack Collins's role in increasing heating oil prices by backing Trump's war. Earlier this week, when Collins released a controversial attack ad through her surrogate Bill Green saying, "we're not talking about buying a cord of wood here, we're sending someone to the U.S. senate," Jackson quickly pivoted the conversation to heating oil prices. "Senator Collins, I think you are a little out of touch. This is about a cord of wood--and about Mainers struggling to afford to heat their homes this winter. I know what it's like to run out of fuel. I've lived that struggle," . "That's the experience I'll take to the U.S. Senate. And I'll use it to fight for working people." Friends,
**We 're coming down to the wire. With Election Day just four days away, the Kansas U.S. Senate race has become THE biggest battleground in the nation. That's why I'm asking for your support ahead of my final end-of-month deadline of this campaign.** Let me explain.
This month alone, ad spending is on track to exceed _**$65 million**_. That's more than is being spent in almost every other Senate battleground -- even in states like Georgia, which has **triple** the population of Kansas!
There's absolutely no doubt about why so much money is being spent on this race: Multiple election forecasters have listed it as a toss-up -- and Nate Silver is calling it the closest race in the nation. That's why, in the final days of this race, Roger Marshall's super PAC allies are spending millions of dollars to air baseless attack ads against me in the hopes of saving this seat for him.
Friends, they never thought Roger Marshall would have any trouble holding on to this seat.
_They weren 't banking on Kansans across the country saying, "No more!" to his failed leadership.
They weren't counting on more than 100,000 grassroots supporters investing in this campaign.
They weren't planning on people like you refusing to write Kansas off -- and instead standing up and doing everything you can to make sure hardworking Kansans get a champion in the Senate._
[Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/941e79a8-565d-44d7-88dc-663326abd572?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
No, they weren't counting on any of that -- and neither was Roger Marshall. **But now, we 're on the verge of pulling off a historic win on Tuesday, and Marshall and his allies in Washington are **_**panicking**_**.**
That's why President Trump and Vice President Vance both came to Kansas to rally for Marshall. And it's why they'll spend even more money in the final days of this race to turn voters against me.
Friends, I _know_ we can win this, but I'll be honest: This eleventh-hour surge in spending is a serious threat. With so much money and so much national attention on this race, the outcome of this election is going to be decided in these last few final days.
We can't leave anything up to chance. My team and I have ads on the air and massive get-out-the-vote efforts underway, but we need the help of grassroots supporters like you to make sure we don't fall behind right in the final stretch.
**This race will come down to the wire, friends -- which means we need to act NOW to reach every last undecided voter. It's no exaggeration to say that in such a competitive race, your grassroots support could be the difference between flipping this seat or suffering through six more years of Roger Marshall's failed leadership. [So please, if you're able, will you chip in whatever you can right now so we can reach our $3 million end-of-month goal by tomorrow at midnight?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/941e79a8-565d-44d7-88dc-663326abd572?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/941e79a8-565d-44d7-88dc-663326abd572?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you for all your support. At this crucial time, every dollar truly does make an impact.
Adam Hamilton

body:
I’m all-in. | | | |
---
| | | _(This email is a little longer than usual. If you’re short on time, I hope you’ll**[split a donation between Next Chapter PAC and me ahead of our final end-of-month fundraising deadline tomorrow.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142541040/657258160/380537607?refcode=261030&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjQ0YTI3NC04NWQ0LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gj41tfIs34BVfIdzQHpLXXJKZmjZiTB2Vw1hrNbwTJs=) **Every donation we receive before the deadline puts us in a stronger position in the final days ahead of the midterms.)**
**_
---
Folks,
When I decided to run for reelection to the U.S. Senate, it was not a decision I made lightly. Asking Virginians to rehire me is a humbling task – and it’s one that I take very seriously.
**But after seeing the crazed, dangerous, and callous actions of the second Trump term, I’m all-in on this race.**
In my time in public service, I’ve never seen anything like I have the last seventeen months. Trump’s policies are skyrocketing prices for working families. They’re stripping health care away from millions of Americans to pay for tax breaks for those at the very top. And their reckless foreign policy is making our country less safe. And all the while, I’ve been disappointed to see too many of my Republican colleagues refuse to take any meaningful action to hold Trump and his reckless administration accountable.
**But frankly, I also know that this race has to be about more than simply what we’re _against_ – we need a vision of what we’re fighting _for_.**
I’m running for reelection to not only continue standing up to the Trump administration’s chaos and corruption, but to also deliver real results for Virginia’s families:
→ We need universal health care in this country. I’ve long supported Obamacare, but simply patching up the old system isn’t cutting it anymore for the families who can’t pay their hospital bills or for life-saving prescriptions.
→ Virginians are facing a housing affordability crisis. We need to build more housing, rehabilitate existing structures, speed up permitting, and make it easier for first-time home buyers to obtain a mortgage.
→ We need to prepare our workforce for the economies of the future – making sure working Americans benefit from the good that could come from Artificial Intelligence and make sure Big Tech pays their fair share for the demand they’re placing on our energy grid.
→ We’ve got to stand up for America’s critical role in the world. That means working with our allies – not against them – and restoring our leadership on the world stage.
**Folks, there’s no doubt these are big challenges – but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight, and I know you aren’t either.**
So here’s the deal: my campaign is coming up on our final end-of-month fundraising deadline and we’ve set an ambitious goal of raising $250,000 from grassroots donors like you before tomorrow at midnight.
These fundraising benchmarks are critical for my fight to protect this Senate seat and elect Democrats in all corners of the Commonwealth to flip the balance of power in Washington. Your support determines what kinds of resources we have in the final days ahead to turn out voters. [**So I’m asking: can I count on your support today to help us reach our fundraising goal? Your donation will be split between my campaign and Next Chapter PAC.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142541041/657258161/380537607?refcode=261030&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZjQ0YTI3NC04NWQ0LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gj41tfIs34BVfIdzQHpLXXJKZmjZiTB2Vw1hrNbwTJs=)

If you’re short on time, I hope you’ll= Every donation we receive before the deadline puts us in a stronger position in the final days ahead of the midterms.) Folks, When I decided to run for reelection to the U.S. Senate, it was not a decision I made lightly. Asking Virginians to rehire me is a humbling task – and it’s one that I take very seriously. But after seeing the crazed, dangerous, and callous actions of the second Trump term, I’m all-in on this race. In my time in public service, I’ve never seen anything like I have the last seventeen months. Trump’s policies are skyrocketing prices for working families. They’re stripping health care away from millions of Americans to pay for tax breaks for those at the very top. And their reckless foreign policy is making our country less safe. And all the while, I’ve been disappointed to see too many of my Republican colleagues refuse to take any meaningful action to hold Trump and his reckless administration accountable. But frankly, I also know that this race has to be about more than simply what we’re against – we need a vision of what we’re fighting for. I’m running for reelection to not only continue standing up to the Trump administration’s chaos and corruption, but to also deliver real results for Virginia’s families: → We need universal health care in this country. I’ve long supported Obamacare, but simply patching up the old system isn’t cutting it anymore for the families who can’t pay their hospital bills or for life-saving prescriptions. → Virginians are facing a housing affordability crisis. We need to build more housing, rehabilitate existing structures, speed up permitting, and make it easier for first-time home buyers to obtain a mortgage. → We need to prepare our workforce for the economies of the future – making sure working Americans benefit from the good that could come from Artificial Intelligence and make sure Big Tech pays their fair share for the demand they’re placing on our energy grid. → We’ve got to stand up for America’s critical role in the world. That means working with our allies – not against them – and restoring our leadership on the world stage. Folks, there’s no doubt these are big challenges – but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight, and I know you aren’t either. So here’s the deal: my campaign is coming up on our final end-of-month fundraising deadline and we’ve set an ambitious goal of raising $250,000 from grassroots donors like you before tomorrow at midnight. These fundraising benchmarks are critical for my fight to protect this Senate seat and elect Democrats in all corners of the Commonwealth to flip the balance of power in Washington. # [Amazon loses over 11% after BRUTAL earnings report](https://substack.com/redirect/05af4d65-9349-49c0-a3af-f635f3910329?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Amazon reported[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/c370d808-aacc-4a7e-abf1-19e544de08ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[third-quarter results that missed expectations](https://substack.com/redirect/c370d808-aacc-4a7e-abf1-19e544de08ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Thursday, with free cash flow plunging to a negative $42.4 billion **[amid massive AI infrastructure spending](https://substack.com/redirect/27e91696-6638-4d39-88c4-4a880d1ec0ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while holding its 2026 capital expenditure forecast at $220 billion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Missed key metrics:** Earnings per share came in at $1.89 versus $1.96 estimated, with revenue of $201.94 billion missing $202.31 billion as advertising fell short at $19.64 billion against $20.82 billion expected.
* **AWS growth accelerates:** Amazon Web Services revenue rose 39% to $45.98 billion, beating estimates, while overall operating margin reached nearly 14%, the highest ever, and the company projected AWS growth above 40% in 2027 and 2028.
* **Record cash outflow:** Trailing twelve-month free cash flow turned to a $42.4 billion outflow, nearly double the prior 2022 record of about $23 billion, driven by roughly $77 billion in property and equipment spending in the quarter.
* **Capex and debt surge:** Full-year 2026 capital expenditure remained guided at $220 billion with more planned for 2027, as long-term debt climbed to about $173 billion from $66 billion at the end of 2025 and shares fell more than 6% after hours.

# [Binance hit by record $6.3B hack as Tether, Circle freeze funds](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Binance disclosed a security incident[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/ec893944-6245-4fa3-8ff1-746ae3e5f93c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[impacting about $6.3 billion in client assets](https://substack.com/redirect/ec893944-6245-4fa3-8ff1-746ae3e5f93c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/ec893944-6245-4fa3-8ff1-746ae3e5f93c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)on Thursday, the largest crypto hack on record, with Circle and Tether freezing roughly $3 billion as the exchange pledged to cover losses.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Largest theft on record:** The breach affected an estimated $6.3 billion, with around $3 billion in assets frozen on-chain so far, as Binance said it found no evidence of any wallet private key leak.
* **Stablecoin freezes:** Circle froze more than 800 million USDC and Tether froze more than 1.5 billion USDT tied to the incident, while Ripple assisted in halting related fund movements.
* **Coverage and recovery:** Binance committed to covering all losses using its Secure Asset Fund for Users and company funds, temporarily suspending withdrawals while expecting to resume them within 48 hours.
* **Market reaction:** Bitcoin fell more than 4% to about $77,995 as the news weighed on crypto markets and Circle shares declined around 5% in after-hours trading.

# [Intel plunges 30% in worst day since 1974](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Intel shares[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/6edf4208-ac37-429a-ab17-ba12875fde3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[tumbled as much as 30%](https://substack.com/redirect/6edf4208-ac37-429a-ab17-ba12875fde3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/6edf4208-ac37-429a-ab17-ba12875fde3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)on Friday after the chipmaker **[issued fourth-quarter guidance well below expectations,](https://substack.com/redirect/dce3743e-cd13-4abe-b202-e6398310bba5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/dce3743e-cd13-4abe-b202-e6398310bba5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)putting the stock on pace for its worst single-day drop since 1974 and erasing more than $100 billion in market value.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Quarter beat expectations:** Adjusted earnings reached 52 cents per share against 40 cents expected, with revenue of $16.51 billion up 21% year over year and data center revenue jumping 78% to $7.3 billion.
* **Guidance disappoints:** The company forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $15 billion to $16 billion versus roughly $17 billion expected and earnings of 25 cents against 43 cents forecast, citing ongoing PC market softness.
* **PC demand weakness:** Intel expects PC shipments to decline about 12% this year and another 10% in 2027, pressured by rising memory costs from AI data center demand and a factory incident in Israel.
* **Historic sell-off:** Only the July 5, 1974 decline of nearly 30% was worse in more than five decades of trading, as the stock remained up more than 80% for the year even after giving back substantial gains from its June peak.

# [Alphabet loses $500B as AI Mode eats search ads](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Alphabet shares plunged nearly 13% on Thursday, **[wiping approximately $500 billion from the Google parent's market value](https://substack.com/redirect/ed2e0eeb-55af-437f-ac82-74404e8e24e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after third-quarter results heightened worries over massive AI infrastructure spending and slowing search advertising growth.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive market wipeout:** Class A shares closed at $283.82, down 12.64%, marking one of the largest single-day market capitalization losses in Wall Street history.
* **Revenue and spending:** Quarterly revenue reached $127.6 billion, up 25% year over year, while capital expenditures hit about $51.4 billion with full-year guidance of $195 billion to $205 billion.
* **Cloud strength:** Google Cloud revenue more than doubled to $30.7 billion, rising 103% from a year earlier and exceeding analyst expectations.
* **Core business pressure:** Investor concerns focused on heavy AI and data center investments alongside slower growth in the core search advertising business that still drives much of the company's revenue.

# [Polymarket freezes after hackers drain $2.7M](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Prediction market platform Polymarket reported an outage on its international exchange on Thursday **[after a hack of a third-party provider led to unauthorized withdrawals,](https://substack.com/redirect/a5c0be6a-fe55-4e3d-b9f5-c948c78fc4d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** prompting a trading halt and referral of the matter to U.K. authorities.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Security incident details:** The issue stemmed from a compromise of DebugBear, a website performance monitoring platform, with users reporting unauthorized fund withdrawals from their wallets.
* **Trading response:** Polymarket halted trading on the international platform as a precaution, fixed the issue on its end, and resumed operations at 3 p.m. ET while pledging to refund affected users.
* **Fund impacts:** Analytics showed one account withdrew at least $2.7 million across 710 wallets, with smaller losses under $10,000 set for restoration by October 30 and larger amounts requiring a release form.
* **Law enforcement:** The company referred the incident to U.K. law enforcement given DebugBear's location there, while confirming its U.S. platform was not affected.

# [Reddit plunges 25% as three tech stocks tank on Q3](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Shares of **[Reddit, Roblox, Pinterest and ServiceNow](https://substack.com/redirect/0f70ff27-a569-4c84-a01b-14460e3d0444?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/0f70ff27-a569-4c84-a01b-14460e3d0444?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)dropped sharply after third-quarter earnings, with Reddit falling nearly 25%, Roblox 22% and ServiceNow 27% as user metrics, guidance and AI payoff timelines disappointed investors.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Reddit and Pinterest declines:** Reddit shares plunged nearly 25% on weaker daily active users and a current-quarter revenue forecast that missed estimates, while Pinterest fell 7% after revenue of $1.17 billion and adjusted earnings of 46 cents both came in below expectations.
* **Roblox user weakness:** Roblox dropped 22% as daily active users declined 9% year over year to 138 million, overshadowing beats on revenue and losses.
* **ServiceNow AI concerns:** **[ServiceNow sank 27%](https://substack.com/redirect/1570f3cd-dcf1-445e-a155-be76bbc36c13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for its worst day on record after revenue of $4.11 billion roughly matched estimates but adjusted earnings of $1.00 missed, reigniting worries over AI disruption and delayed returns from new engineering investments.
* **Guidance and context:** ServiceNow slightly raised its full-year subscription revenue outlook while Reddit plans to test login requirements for forums, and all moves added to broader tech selling pressure.

# [Nvidia denies report China targeted Jensen Huang as spy](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia rejected a New York Times report on Thursday that **[U.S. intelligence agencies had surveilled a suspected Chinese asset](https://substack.com/redirect/d12b34c5-19f1-4bda-9bd0-a97622007bbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who met multiple times with CEO Jensen Huang, calling the interactions routine for a major customer.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e22af466-a7f4-4ce0-b56b-675cdcec6c1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Report details:** The account centered on Alice Huang, or Huang Le, a former executive at Singapore-based cloud company Megaspeed, who U.S. officials monitored over possible export control evasion and who **[developed a relationship with the Nvidia CEO.](https://substack.com/redirect/e04d7add-431c-4783-b5ec-d0c0f3ed0c68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Nvidia response:** A spokesperson said Huang meets thousands of customer executives annually, that such meetings were not unusual, and that customers do not receive trade secrets or national security information.
* **Prior scrutiny:** Nvidia stated that diversion allegations against Megaspeed were thoroughly investigated and debunked last year, and that the company was not briefed by the U.S. government on any concerns about the individual.
* **Official reactions:** Chinese authorities rejected the claims as groundless speculation, while the report noted Huang's discussions with President Trump on AI and export controls.

In 2000, two men worked at a start-up called PayPal that lost money on nearly every transaction and called it the future. One was Elon Musk, who went on to buy the internet's loudest square and rename it X. The other was Reid Hoffman, who went on to build LinkedIn, the quieter square where people describe themselves as "results-driven." They were the PayPal mafia then. They are two of the richest men in America now. And this week, their twenty-five-year acquaintance reaches its natural conclusion: a proxy war over a United States Senate seat in Texas, five days before the vote.

Friend,
---
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let us explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.

More shifts, more doors, more calls, all focused on reaching every voter who still hasn’t returned a ballot. I’ll be out there with them. I’ve been thinking a lot this week about where we were two years ago. In 2024, plenty of people didn’t think we could flip this seat. We did it because folks like you stepped up in the final stretch, chipped in what you could, and showed up when it mattered most. That’s the only reason I’m in Congress today. clean_body: | = Peter, This is it: we’re heading into the last weekend before Election Day. Our volunteers have been out knocking doors and making calls for months, and this weekend we’re putting everything we have into one final push. More shifts, more doors, more calls, all focused on reaching every voter who still hasn’t returned a ballot. I’ll be out there with them. I’ve been thinking a lot this week about where we were two years ago. In 2024, plenty of people didn’t think we could flip this seat. We did it because folks like you stepped up in the final stretch, chipped in what you could, and showed up when it mattered most. That’s the only reason I’m in Congress today. Now I’m asking voters to send me back so I can keep doing this work, and so we can help Democrats take back the House and put a real check on this administration. Derek, **Election Day is in four days,** so we wanted to send a quick note about the critical work the DNC is doing to help Democrats win and [**ask you to make your first contribution today.**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-eom-october-2026.a6x_w1&refcode=em_20261030_10170_fr&amount=7&t=6&akid=10170%2E22930333%2ED6ImZB)** _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | | **[CONTRIBUTE $7](https://ak.democrats.org/go/89866?c0=em-dnc-eom-october-2026.gNKhUL&amount=7&refcode=em_20261030_10170_fr&t=7&akid=10170%2E22930333%2ED6ImZB)**

The DNC has been making historic investments into our midterm operation. We’ve called thousands of voters who sat out 2024 through our Local Listeners program, sent volunteers to organize in every corner of the country, made record-breaking investments into every single state Democratic party, deployed an army of organizers, and are mobilizing poll watchers across the country to help every voter make their voice heard.
**But our work isn’t over.**
Think about your friends or relatives who don’t always vote. There are millions of people just like them, in communities all over the country.
In these final days before the polls close, **it’s our job to reach those people.** It’s up to us to communicate the stakes to Democratic voters and make sure they turn out to the polls in droves.
As you can imagine, that work isn’t easy — and we rely heavily on grassroots contributions to fund it. That’s why we’re asking you to make your first contribution of 2026 today.

**OCTOBER 30, 2026**
We assume that once trash leaves our sight, the story is over--but for much of what we discard, the story is just beginning. **What dictates the path an item takes?**
Some items belong in ordinary garbage; others require specialized handling. A cleaner, paint thinner, battery, or computer differs from household garbage. Some can be recycled; others require specialized collection or treatment. Sumter County's November 7 Amnesty Day accepts items that should not go into ordinary garbage.
Ordinary garbage has a classification, too. Clearwater's record calls its diverted waste _putrescible solid waste_ --organic material capable of decomposition. When Pinellas County's waste-to-energy plant experienced turbine problems, Clearwater arranged to divert its putrescible solid waste to Heart of Florida Landfill beginning October 1. The arrangement is projected through December 2026.
Clearwater illustrates how waste can take a different path when its usual destination is unavailable. **Those decisions have consequences --not only for the environment where waste is deposited, but for the communities that live there.** **What determines those decisions, and who is accountable along the way?**
**Ivette DECODES.
**_The Heart of What Matters._
* * *
**COMING NEXT WEEK**
A landfill is the destination. But what are the unseen mechanics that drive it?
Our three-part _Receipts_ investigation follows the decisions, agreements, and movement of waste surrounding Heart of Florida Landfill.
* * *

Do we know where it goes? | | | Oct 30 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- OCTOBER 30, 2026 We assume that once trash leaves our sight, the story is over--but for much of what we discard, the story is just beginning. What dictates the path an item takes? Some items belong in ordinary garbage; others require specialized handling. A cleaner, paint thinner, battery, or computer differs from household garbage. Some can be recycled; others require specialized collection or treatment. Sumter County's November 7 Amnesty Day accepts items that should not go into ordinary garbage. Ordinary garbage has a classification, too. Clearwater's record calls its diverted waste putrescible solid waste --organic material capable of decomposition. When Pinellas County's waste-to-energy plant experienced turbine problems, Clearwater arranged to divert its putrescible solid waste to Heart of Florida Landfill beginning October 1. The arrangement is projected through December 2026. Clearwater illustrates how waste can take a different path when its usual destination is unavailable. Those decisions have consequences --not only for the environment where waste is deposited, but for the communities that live there. We’re just four days out from Election Day, so if we fall short of our fundraising goals now, there won’t be another opportunity to make up the gap. [ ]Just a $15 donation from everyone reading this email will put our campaign in a better spot before tomorrow night. Can I count on you to rush $15 today? [ ]Donate → Thanks so much, Josh Shapiro

body:
I need you to vote now!
| | | | [](https://link.emails.bofrench.)
---
|
---
[](https://link.emails.bofrench.)
| | friend,
Today is the last day of early voting, and polls are open until 7pm.
Because you are a Patriot, I’m sure you have already voted or have a solid plan to vote on election day.
If you are an election day voter, I urge you to vote today and get it over with so nothing happens to prevent you from voting tuesday.
If you have already voted, there is still one thing you can do for me.
Text everyone you know and tell them to vote today.
If you haven’t already downloaded the Abbott Impact App, you should do that as well.
With the Abbott Impact App, you can merge your contacts into the app to see which of your friends and family haven’t voted yet.
You would be surprised how many of your Patriot friends and family haven’t voted.
We have to get as many Republicans to the polls as possible.
Right now, Democrats have a statewide advantage in early voting. You might be surprised by that, but let me break it down: among the millions of ballots cast statewide, currently more people with a democrat-only primary voting history have voted than people with Republican-only primary voting history.
Historically, Republicans win the election day vote, but we can’t leave anything up to chance.
You have been with me through everything, from the primary until now.
Thank you for your support, whether that has been your gracious donations, sharing my social media posts to get the word out, or telling your friends to vote.
You are the bedrock on which this campaign is built, and I am grateful for you.
Let’s bring this thing home.

**Today is the last day of early voting in Texas.**
What we raise between now and Election Day is how we make sure we continue to see historic turnout.

Donald Trump won this district by 18 points in 2024. Monica De La Cruz won by 14.

| | | Peter, this month, pundits shifted over thirty races toward Democrats. That sounds huge. It _is_ huge. **But here’s why we can’t listen to the pundits on this.** All month, Republicans and Elon Musk have been doubling down on their investments in close races across the country. They’ve flooded the airwaves with vile attacks, and when so many folks across the country are still undecided, those attacks make a difference — especially when Democrats can’t compete with their multi-million dollar ad buys. I’ve been on the ground in major battleground states like Texas over the last few weeks, and Democrats’ energy is _incredible_ right now. But we’ve been here before: Democrats put up strong numbers, our chances of winning get upgraded in the final stretch, and in the last make-or-break days before Election Day, we come up short because we put too much stock in what the pundits are saying instead of what we’re doing to bring our races across the finish line. **We’re not sitting on our hands over the next 4 days. We’re on the ground, we’re ensuring our candidates have ad budgets to get them all the way through Election Day, and we’re not leaving anything up to chance.** **[If that sounds worth five or ten bucks to you, pitch in so we can leave everything on the floor between now and when polls close on Election Day. I’ve been on the ground in major battleground states like Texas over the last few weeks, and Democrats’ energy is incredible right now. But we’ve been here before: Democrats put up strong numbers, our chances of winning get upgraded in the final stretch, and in the last make-or-break days before Election Day, we come up short because we put too much stock in what the pundits are saying instead of what we’re doing to bring our races across the finish line. We’re not sitting on our hands over the next 4 days. We’re on the ground, we’re ensuring our candidates have ad budgets to get them all the way through Election Day, and we’re not leaving anything up to chance. = = | | | Four days. subject: Ted Cruz is “deeply, deeply worried.”
body:
They’ve spent $181 million against us and they’re worried...
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, I never thought I’d be quoting Ted Cruz in an email to you. But here we are.
On his podcast today, Ted Cruz told millions of listeners he is **“deeply, deeply worried”** about the midterm elections. Then he said this about Texas:
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261030_4_tedcruz.xuI0lh&refcode=em20261030-2610&t=1&akid=2610%2E299639%2EUn5fCj)
_“Texas is excruciatingly close. Understand, we could lose Texas. Let me repeat that.**We could lose Texas. And by the way, not just the Senate race. We could lose every single statewide race in Texas. That’s how close these numbers are****.** ”_
—Ted Cruz**
**
Every single statewide race. That includes ours.
Ted Cruz said, “I don’t want to wake up in a world where Texas is all blue.” [**Well, if flipping Texas blue is worth even a few dollars, I’m asking you to chip in now.**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261030_4_tedcruz.xuI0lh&refcode=em20261030-2610&t=2&akid=2610%2E299639%2EUn5fCj)
Think about what it took to get here. Greg Abbott has spent $181 million against us. He’s outspent us more than 5 to 1. **And four days out, Republicans are still begging their own voters to show up.**
You’re the reason they’re panicking. Every $5 and $10 gift that kept this campaign on the air when the experts said Texas was out of reach has turned into momentum and a campaign that can win.
Now Cruz says it all comes down to whether his voters show up on Tuesday. Abbott will spend everything he has left to make sure they do.**We have to make sure every Texan on our side shows up too.**
Our October goal is $10 million. **We’re 93% of the way there, and the deadline is tomorrow at midnight.**
If you’ve been waiting to see whether this race is really winnable, take it from Ted Cruz. [**Will you make your first-ever donation of $15 today and help us prove him right?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1374?c0=em_ms_gh_20261030_4_tedcruz.A_MLWU&refcode=em20261030-2610&t=5&akid=2610%2E299639%2EUn5fCj)

Early voting ends today. Election Day is Tuesday.
Ted Cruz is afraid of waking up to a blue Texas on Wednesday. Let’s give him a reason to be.
Thank you,
Gina

body:
What happens in the Rio Grande Valley this election cycle will determine whether we can flip these races or not.
#
Peter,
Election Day is on Tuesday, and the path to victory for major races runs straight through the Rio Grande Valley.
**We’ve identified 115,000 Latino voters across the Rio Grande Valley that we need to turn out to vote by mail and cast their ballots in this critical election.**
These are voters who hold the power to decide the governor's race, flip a crucial U.S. Senate seat, and decide battleground congressional districts like TX-15. But right now, we’re falling behind.
We currently only have the dedicated funds to reach 85,000 of these voters.
That leaves a 30,000 voter gap — and in an election this close, leaving 30,000 voters out is a huge risk, and one that we don’t want to take.
When we reach voters directly with the right information and concrete voting plans, Latinos turn out in historic numbers. **But if we go dark in these final days, those 30,000 voters may never hear from an organizer before the polls close.**

clean_body: I just left South Carolina. This race is neck and neck, and Darline needs us now. | Fellow Patriot, On Monday, I was in South Carolina, on the campaign trail with Darline Graham. I want to tell you what I saw, because this race is closer than anyone in Washington wants to admit. It is neck and neck. Election Day is less than a week away, and Darline's seat could swing either way. Here's what I told the folks there: -> You don't want a Senate run by Chuck Schumer. -> You don't want Elizabeth Warren to chair the Senate Banking Committee. -> And you don't want Bernie Sanders setting environmental policy that kills jobs in South Carolina. That's the radical Democrat agenda, and it's what Annie Andrews would be voting for. She's raised over $25 million - nearly $4 million in the last couple of weeks - from liberal donors who don't share South Carolina's values. She built her campaign attacking Lindsey, and now her whole mission is to defeat his sister. Darline stands for common sense: low taxes, good jobs, and backing the police. She won't vote to put violent criminals back on the street or to let boys compete in girls' sports. She has thirty years of experience working for the people of her state, and she has a backbone. What Darline doesn't have is Hollywood money. Schumer needs JUST FOUR SEATS to take the majority, and he's betting South Carolina hands him one because Darline is being outspent after running two elections back-to-back. Fellow Patriot, races this close are decided in the final days by who can stay on the air, keep volunteers knocking doors, and get voters to the polls. They tried this playbook on me in Texas. National Democrats dumped millions to attack me because they thought the bigger bank account would win. Now I'm making a personal plea: show up for Darline. | | | | | | We have less than a week. Let's not sit this one out. name: Speaker Mike Johnson
subject: There’s really no one else like Jen
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
She’s a no-nonsense conservative fighter facing her toughest battle yet...

| | | | | Peter, we’re on the precipice of greatness, but that can all be washed away if we lose focus on the long-term goal: Defending the House Majority in 2026.
---
| | **THE BAD NEWS**
---
| | Democrats are using our Republican trifecta as a powerful motivating tool to rile up their deep-pocketed liberal donors. Democrats are raising millions of dollars and have released their list of TOP TARGETS for 2026, and right on that list is: Jen Kiggans.
---
| | **ABOUT JEN**
---
| | Finding someone like Jen is as tough as can be: it’s nearly impossible. Jen joined our ranks in 2022, where she flipped a BLUE seat RED. In 2024, Jen defended her seat by just 3.8% — we came dangerously close to losing this GOP superstar.

There’s no one else like Jen:
---
| |
* Jen comes from a long line of veterans: She followed in her family’s footsteps when she felt called to serve as a Navy helicopter pilot in the Persian Gulf.
* After her service in the Navy, Jen continued to serve her community as an Adult-Geriatric Primary Care Nurse Practitioner.

Folks, this is how I feel when my Campaign Manager says I need to ask you for money.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a0a37b7f-793c-4145-933c-2504dd06752a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I'm a working guy -- I know how hard folks are working to keep their families fed and their bills paid.
### **Unfortunately, the alternative is way worse.**
Susan Collins doesn't need to ask grassroots supporters for cash to fuel her campaign.
She calls up one of her nearly 100 billionaire donors to cut a fat check when she needs an influx of cash.
**So she doesn 't answer to you; she answers to the nearly 10% of US billionaires who give to her campaign.**
So as much as I hate writing these emails and asking you for money, this is the only way we can run a campaign for and by working-class folks. And look, I need your support right now if we are going to beat Susan Collins.
### **We can 't fall short.**
We are up against our biggest and most important goal yet: raise $2,000,000 before our end-of-month deadline on October 31st.
**[Will you chip in now to help us hit our final end-of-month goal and flip the Senate?](https://substack.com/redirect/a0a37b7f-793c-4145-933c-2504dd06752a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ CHIP IN NOW ->](https://substack.com/redirect/a0a37b7f-793c-4145-933c-2504dd06752a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### **I need to be clear with you:**
Whether or not we hit our fundraising goals has never been more important. This race is razor-thin, and who comes out on top will depend entirely on who can run more ads and turn out more voters in these final days.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a0a37b7f-793c-4145-933c-2504dd06752a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **This fundraising goal isn 't just a number I made up.**
$2,000,000 is the goal my Campaign Manager and our team set to ensure we can counter Susan Collins' massive attack ad spending AND fuel our ambitious Voter Turnout Programs.
### **Hitting this goal is how we win.**
And if we don't hit it, we will be ending October behind. With just 4 days until Election Day, if you fall behind, you don't have time to catch up.
So it isn't just ads or voter turnout that would suffer, but then we'd have to rethink how many yard signs we can print, how many mailers we can send, how many voters we can reach.
### **You get the idea -- falling short means losing to Susan.**
**[So, as much as I hate to keep asking you for money, I have to ask again: will you chip in to help us hit our $2,000,000 deadline before midnight? We're so close. ->](https://substack.com/redirect/a0a37b7f-793c-4145-933c-2504dd06752a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[CHIP IN NOW ->](https://substack.com/redirect/a0a37b7f-793c-4145-933c-2504dd06752a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Solidarity forever,
Troy Jackson

body:
September 11th changed my life forever.

| Peter,
How many members of Congress do you know who can fly nearly every type of aircraft, have developed a successful tech startup and enlisted in the Air Force at 34 years old?
My name is Troy Downing – can you give me just a couple of minutes of your time to share my story? I promise you, it's not going to be one you'll forget.
In my youth, I helped develop graphics technology at an NYU lab that won an Academy Award and built a successful startup that merged with Yahoo!
And in 2001, I had a beautiful life. I went from a dirt-poor childhood to having a beautiful wife, a home, and four kids of my own.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
Then came September 11th.
Like millions of Americans, I watched the horror of that day unfold. But as a 34-year-old businessman, I couldn't just sit back and watch others fight for our freedom.
I knew I had to give back to the country that gave me everything.
I walked right into a military recruitment office, looked the recruiter in the eye, and said, "Hey, I have a commercial pilot's license, I used to teach math at NYU – what can you do with me?"
I signed on the dotted line, went to boot camp, and proudly joined a U.S. Air Force Combat Search and Rescue squadron.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning._XFscz81vHrKPK8mWsY5yA)
---
I served eight years and did two tours of duty in Afghanistan on grueling rescue missions to save wounded soldiers on the battlefield. Our squadron lived by a sacred motto:
“These things we do, that others may live.”
And after two tours in Afghanistan, the good people of Montana elected me to the U.S. House of Representatives – I’ve even been endorsed by President Trump TWICE!
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
But right now, the battlefield has changed – and the stakes have never been higher. I am running for re-election to Congress, and every single seat in these Midterms matters if we want to protect and defend our GOP House Majority.
Peter, I’m not someone who loves asking for money. In fact, it’s one of the hardest parts of this job. But the reality of modern campaigns is that I cannot fight this battle alone. I don’t need a small fortune from a few wealthy insiders – I need a strong team of everyday patriots standing in the trenches with me.
If you believe that Washington needs more leaders who put country over self, and if you want to make sure our House of Representatives stays firmly in conservative hands, I would be deeply grateful for your support.
[If you are able, would you consider making a humble, secure contribution of $25, $50, or $100 today? Every dollar, every CENT goes directly toward defending this seat and keeping our GOP House Majority alive.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._gX0Ww)
---

---
| [CHIP IN $50](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
| [CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
Thank you for your time, your support, and your shared love for this country.
God Bless you,
Troy Downing
U.S. Representative, Montana's 2nd District

TODAY'S TOP STORIES

PETITION SEEKS TO DISQUALIFY KILLIN FROM CO-5 BALLOT DAYS BEFORE
ELECTION
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

Wayne Laugesen published a court petition on Oct. 29 asking a Denver
judge to declare Jessica Killin unqualified for a ballot that has been
in voters’ hands since early October. Election Day is Tuesday.

The verified petition names Killin, the Democrat nominee in
Colorado’s 5th Congressional District, and Secretary of State Jena
Griswold in her official capacity.

The constitutional requirement is one sentence. A member of the House
must, when elected, be an inhabitant of the state. The petition says
Killin will not be.

Its central document is an Oct. 1, 2026 Montgomery County, Maryland
property tax bill for a house in Chevy Chase that Killin owns with her
husband, Rajeev Date. That bill designates the property their
principal residence, according to the petition, and an earlier bill
for the same house, covering 2016 to 2017, said it was not one.

READ MORE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BAUER: YOUR VOTE DOES COUNT, SO PLEASE VOTE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHIRLEY BAUER, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

_With 14 ballot measures at stake, a guest columnist urges Coloradans
not to sit out an election she says will shape taxes, parental rights,
and gun and hunting rights for years to come._

*
A DIRECT VOTING RECOMMENDATION: The author urges a NO vote on
Proposition NN, Amendment 87 and Proposition 137, and a YES vote on
all other measures, framing the choice as giving citizens, not state
government, the final say on these issues.

*
FRAMED AS A RESPONSE TO ONE-PARTY RULE: Bauer argues eight years of
Democratic control in Colorado have produced over 18 mandated school
laws and more than 21 anti-gun laws, and that grassroots
signature-gathering put these measures on the ballot specifically to
let voters reclaim ground she says has been legislated away.

*
A PRACTICAL VOTING REMINDER: She disputes the claim that Proposition
NN would direct 50% of its funds to teacher pay, calling it false, and
advises voters to drop their ballots at an official drop box or voter
center rather than mailing them, given the risk ballots won’t arrive
in time to be counted.

NOT CODIFIED
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | OCTOBER 29

_More than three and a half hours into a Denver Public Schools board
work session on Oct. 8, Director Kimberlee Sia asked whether families
would walk into school choice this year and find the same schools they
expected. She put the question to the superintendent and to her fellow
board members, “because obviously we make this decision."_

__

DAVIDSON: THE PERFECT STORM CONSPIRES IN FRANCE AND EUROPE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY JAY DAVIDSON | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 29

_A perfect storm led to Europe’s riots. The same trend could happen
here. Fortunately, President Trump has managed to stop the influx of
illegals. We have those disaffected young males with which to contend,
but at least the influx has stopped._

__

CRAIG COAL PLANT: 3 COLORADO CASES FREEZE WHILE DOE SEEKS A REHEARING
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | OCTOBER 28

_Craig Station Unit 1 was supposed to shut down on Dec. 31, 2025.
Nearly 10 months later, it is still under federal order to stay
available to operate. On Monday, Oct. 26, the Department of Energy
(DOE) asked the full D.C. Circuit to throw out a September ruling that
narrowed its power to issue those orders._

major legal headaches. Many states strictly ban "electioneering" near
polling places. If you wear a mask, costume, or satirical outfit
depicting a candidate or policy to the voting booth, poll workers are
legally required to make you remove it before you can cast your
ballot.

Peter

My name is Justin Early, and I am running for Congress in Texas’s 31st District.

I grew up in a military family, served as a paratrooper in the 82nd Airborne, worked at the Pentagon after 9/11, and today I work in cybersecurity protecting the systems our economy and democracy depend on. My wife and I raised seven children and now we live in the heart of Georgetown. I am running because working families like mine are doing everything right and still falling behind.

I believe how a campaign is funded shapes how someone legislates.

This campaign is powered by small donations from working families across TX-31. That is not just a fundraising strategy. It is a statement about accountability.

When a campaign is funded by regular people, the candidate answers to regular people. It is working families like yours and mine across TX-31 funding us through small donations that make a big impact. Teachers. Veterans. Nurses. Union members. Parents trying to keep up with rising costs. That is who I am running to represent.

I am not self-funding this race nor am I taking corporate PAC money. This is intentional. Because I want this campaign to belong to the community. Grassroots support means shared ownership. It means the priorities of working families stay at the center of every decision.

I have the honor to have earned the endorsement of the AFL-CIO COPE committee. They understood that I am running to represent the people who are doing everything right and still falling behind, not to buy a seat in Congress. A campaign funded by working families answers to working families. That is who I will always be accountable to.

If you believe TX-31 deserves a representative funded by the people, I am asking you to be part of this effort.

I’ve been through a number of midterm elections, and I can honestly say that this one is the most consequential.
**Just four seats will determine the House majority, meaning we can't afford to lose any incumbents. And it's especially critical that we don't lose a trusted ally in our own backyard.**
The stability of our democracy is on the line, and we need to keep Democrats like Eric who will hold this administration accountable, while never losing focus on the economic challenges facing the American people.
But what I appreciate most about Eric is that he's a hometown candidate who has run people-powered campaigns that depend on individual donors -- his neighbors. At a time when outside spending has soared, he's held firm to his values, and he'll never sell out this district to the highest bidder.

name: Keith Ellison
subject: My opponent’s conflicts of interest
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keith Ellison for Attorney General
body:
My opponent has financial stakes in companies Minnesota is suing—and won’t say when he’d stand up to Trump.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=partner_em261030ke_smalltownpac.0M1SHR&amount=5&refcode=em20261030-1290&t=1&akid=1290%2E34582%2EvgV7_E)
Peter,
I’ve spent my time as Attorney General taking on powerful interests and winning for Minnesotans. Lowering the cost of insulin. Getting workers their stolen wages back. Holding scammers and fraudsters accountable. And standing up to Donald Trump’s abuses of power.
My Republican opponent, Ron Schutz, is a wealthy corporate lawyer with a financial stake in the very companies an Attorney General may need to hold accountable.
His financial disclosures show at least $1.74 million in stock holdings across 174 companies, including at least six that Minnesota is suing. His investments include Big Pharma and Big Tech—the same powerful interests I’ve been willing to take on.
**And at our first debate, he couldn’t name a single instance in which he would stand up to Donald Trump.**
**[Minnesotans need a People’s Lawyer who will stand up to powerful interests and Trump’s abuses of power. Will you split a donation of $10, $25, $50, or whatever works for you between Small Town PAC and my campaign to help me win and keep doing that work?](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=partner_em261030ke_smalltownpac.0M1SHR&amount=5&refcode=em20261030-1290&t=2&akid=1290%2E34582%2EvgV7_E)**
The public should never have to wonder whether their Attorney General is refusing to sue a company because he owns stock in it. Or whether he’ll let Donald Trump get away with hurting Minnesotans because they’re in the same party.
**I’ve never backed down from those fights, and I’m not starting now.**
But Republican megadonors have spent millions to distort my record, and a poll already shows me behind. Schutz has also loaned his own campaign $450,000 to try to keep it that way.
We cannot let them buy this office and undo the work we’ve done. We need to keep our ads on the air and our organizers in the field, making sure voters hear the truth about who will fight for them.
**[I don’t take corporate PAC money. I’m counting on this grassroots team to help us fight back and win. Will you make a contribution today, split between Small Town PAC and my campaign, to keep the People’s Lawyer in Minnesotans’ corner?](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=partner_em261030ke_smalltownpac.0M1SHR&amount=5&refcode=em20261030-1290&t=3&akid=1290%2E34582%2EvgV7_E)**

Thank you for standing with me,
Keith Ellison

| Earlier this month, Breitbart wrote an entire article about me, and I have to admit, I'm a little impressed by how thoroughly they studied my platform.
They dug up an interview where I talked about coming from a long line of proud Black socialists and radicals who understood that you can't fight for racial justice without fighting for economic justice. They found my support for making reproductive freedom a constitutional right and even found my Trans Bill of Rights.
And then, naturally, they slapped a scary headline on it and described abortion and trans health care in language I'm not going to repeat here.

Hi there, it's Michele Tafoya!

If I were to take a guess, there's a 50/50 chance you may recognize me from a stadium's big screen.
If that's not the case, I get it... Let me at least tell you briefly about who I am and what I'm about anyway!

I should clarify first, no, I didn't make my career running for touchdowns or kicking game-winning field goals.

I worked as a sideline reporter in professional football for nearly three decades. Working in the sport for that long was a dream come true, and I wouldn't have wanted it any other way.
[Believe me, I know plenty of people who called me crazy for walking away from a career I loved. But life is short, and I was not willing to sit on the sidelines while everything I care about was on the line.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=133a5b4d07ec4b72862b20f8f7a3686d&_e=vEDuIesGOv0FXkAj45iwzbEE0lN-xVVyRAjN3C79QcpI3B7MWqHHLznNe5DoAq-Rk5GHT9us-qvrXH05LxDWM8Bl2jxbNDbqk3FcaNuHF7_Hohzrk-XILK7k54vxZMVtUdYuqF6v2Bye1rJy8BFze5DlB8J-Sd1ASaR8r8-Z7Hg9nQS2yiwVLBr4BZIdsPPrIAaqm3-Jz8fnMZtxWK-wzBPKvughWpi1xfbV1aCF0AYBER5wjvSEs7bzq_CDXxIbh6P_Kp9TUsEWiFilIqTp9UBoK9_K7Qfh1Ky_Geo0x6YuMG3bUJmTpnVb3wsHUVAq6zYBOyO6wN5A_5D4ooKRUpI4S6XEbZnQwzOHnHd5Yk0dt9AXFfNuBZ4Lx4zYsnIBJRPTt5z5U2VujPGRbdqJgwtsl6G5UoaeNSY9XpAb1dQtuS-hHMt2Eg_X7zxjtVw2fqD2teQdS672AvdXr4mSvQ24xzfeyCn5c1CI_0JrO43RRjaMd3K26R3hPdBfDZxGq74nI5OXIMZCPJRsC9yiPONpXQW92loCiz2Iowwe141pGZQBjzSeXcfRg_goP_lBr5s5Dh8y9mFoH1zGOGlvkxeNHVmvVKQBOYHLxhgH0_lHa27VM3X_v447uA7Z1Wk6Nt7g4wmdGlMvpnxxK40ay4xX-3KLBs_vqCCdcjUhSpc9vbW5RBmwmDg5rrRzGZZ6NYfh7Uu12anZxsw8RZ9afiYSohxsoxW8j7Ehbq8QWdr6ykzqqHq2pwDS0QtDFFMgk-BQB0pdSWpUgcrc41DiB54iigarGSRh5I4l_1T9dJjJROgQM0c2uwtoQmKLwRj6vS3hmPcx7TZomoVjucFjKp2xcm4AcPCGUe6Q1MHuAu38WDRDzN3tlS3SGenbLkj0ySFxqtRM0WsLTpq-YkmxCtuF2B5Gbz9DwEWlMi7PrR8ac4DSmLEx2A1xyVSVA2Vq1dKPJQe91csR1YkspDDqycmKqVGRyC88fMX-Bk337KHBYNHNsPhFKgE4vAw7QaJi)
I told myself before I officially launched my race for U.S. Senate that we had to be all in or not do it at all.

I burned the boats, Patriot, and there's absolutely no looking back.
I will not be canceled. I will not apologize for values that are wholesome and good. And if my voice gives someone else the courage to use theirs, that is exactly why I did it.

I want my daughter and every young American to know one thing:
You earn your place. You think for yourself. And you never let anyone put you in a box. That's the Minnesota I'm fighting for.
Parents who speak up are called transphobes.Girls who lose opportunities are told to be quiet.And women's groups are nowhere to be found.
This is not complicated.
Girls' sports are for girls, and boys' sports are for boys.

The radical Left has done everything in its power to infiltrate some of the most vulnerable minds in our society. I launched this run because just like you, I'm sick of the indoctrination and want to bring back sanity to our country.

It's going to be FAR from easy. Minnesota hasn't had a Republican Senator in nearly two decades! However, it's ripe for a flip....with the disastrous leadership of Governor Walz and the Democratic Party in the state, people are fed up.

It's going to take a grassroots army of patriots, just like you, to propel this movement of ours to victory and shock the world.

The right to choose what to do with your body is up for a vote, thanks to the captured Supreme Court. | |
---
Peter, In a democracy, you should never have to vote to save your rights. **Thanks to the captured Supreme Court, that’s exactly what’s happening this November.** When the Roberts Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , they left the issue of abortion up to the states to decide. Now, on ballots across the country, voters will decide whether women have reproductive rights or not. Ballot initiatives and referendums are just as important as the candidates we choose on Election Day. **But not enough of us are paying close enough attention to what’s on our ballots.** That’s why we need to make sure to spread the word in the last week before the midterm elections, to make sure voters across the country know that their reproductive rights are up for a vote. **Can you share this graphic far and wide? Make sure your friends, family, and online community know that it’s time to go vote for your rights!** [****](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWn3R7U15hZOprFI75oZg46bx-NM31jPTPHnk56GnKwYAD56E3hNx1kGaOMZhhBbd4G8HHB8kTirVJ9PtzUym-DwVSwxwdolSYgbH3nn5KmNLk-sApwbd2Bp7NiWrbNJfN7WcLwhncay6Ji7dwIcySt2bu7zFAB0t4XDtM3be-LOjScOwK1bwRXQTzkMHubgVSUK7_y92IYnMuhDo-QvxwLNvLiwk89QppHMYMcHUt4-LCOaNBibDpQey8LAVlkXNx3VjxxC5xZ6ebz1-L7s_TegyvJE2bJ3HdBhonHiKaFF1EcUEXCHXZsv2-f4SKbMHQ/4vb/SHIezvyiQjmvJvXsKcqm9w/h0/h001.4GJjijsGzAIj1G_-4z_b787-TnGlO7D-Qar4zWCeVpU) | [SHARE ON INSTAGRAM](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWn3R7U15hZOprFI75oZg46bx-NM31jPTPHnk56GnKwYAD56E3hNx1kGaOMZhhBbd1plzHzDVPHaQL9NXc4Nl7TYxBawtO6R8s8zqSobWQaciz9bxMyXUmPdxjmZhASHFlTcH8Ra5bvqGjNcljzyTlVWeaZve48WD4pv2jVJQBB67ibyNG-DXl4nKr0zMTqBvwxyHyjgWdC3KYgvNQbx1RBDnjWC4z6ad0OzXx9oHe8AQ_tzgUOIFG9GFJtaw5z1WBovNx0Dd7m8lDeOcJk5_e9yppAhpvvca4PhtkbRI7CWRv3MU-DSX-Li8bvNBF6-0g/4vb/SHIezvyiQjmvJvXsKcqm9w/h1/h001.MOej3Osa9WsgmYL9gvdPy_F5xv1L0HMRYvYD8-9m6wQ) | [SHARE ON TWITTER](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.IrwCNRMzSkXvFsTjBP9k2GvHymcFxedlvcuyJ_L8250wB9FJA_pKMmfxM6x8y9TFgrHN4mVnhoPlz6BEUrgEKjsEVjXC2V_3iTw8Dj57RFc3cCQuQkifD2UEjF9ZMyxOG2dfj44QqQNapeH4qd0kglJSh3frlF56x5VC-EYqLVe1Vlh20TnGywYEQoTjJs0i4im6lDXnTLjAoa402AQCCcKT0I_-e86OXEVawegSwiGxHdUT3Gl0ijM_rzo_PN3K3AvyUIUb11M7FfJYAIdke4HPi13ZilLzoRCXCzb1Fpmocmv1rnWpyfmij8CVrynHrvTbPEGITYy6C_wq1-4SYSp2KjIpL04hFvaM76pBZgIE82Rsu-3qivyBownAnFqq/4vb/SHIezvyiQjmvJvXsKcqm9w/h2/h001.62OYnQr8j1C9mBrVtIvibtkjYVUzOffQ-hqFy2a4V9k)

Everyone in America needs to understand what’s at stake here. But in particular, Idaho, Nevada, Virginia, and Missouri have the opportunity to make their voices loud and clear with their vote on their state’s abortion ballot measures.
**When abortion rights are put up for a vote, the pro-choice answer wins almost every time. That’s because a wide majority of Americans believe in the right to choose!** 1
But the shadowy, wealthy right-wing extremists who packed the Court against the people are working overtime to make sure you don’t vote, or that your vote doesn’t count.
**We have to turn out in droves and prove to the wannabe dictators in this country that we live in a democracy that’s ruled by the people and for the people. We won’t be bought, and we refuse to allow our rights to be stripped away.**
It’s time to share, text, and call everyone you know. Make sure they have a plan to vote and that they know their rights are on the line.
Thank you for taking the time to remind your community that abortion is on the ballot,
Morgan Stahr
United for Democracy

body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, I know
exactly what your inbox looks like right now.

Every campaign in the country is closing its books on the last
End-of-Month fundraising deadline of the election — and I bet you’ve
already received a dozen emails about it (including the ones from me and
my team).

I’m genuinely sorry to add to the pile!

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22128?t=1001&akid=881%2E245147%2E4_P6kf ]But I’d rather be honest with you about where we are. We’re still
pacing $70,765 short of tomorrow night’s fundraising goal, so I have to
ask: Will you rush
$25 right now?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22128?t=1002&akid=881%2E245147%2E4_P6kf ]Donate →

Here’s why I think ours is worth reading,
Derek.

In 2016, Donald Trump won Pennsylvania by 1%. In 2020, Joe Biden won it by
1%. In 2024, Republicans took a Senate seat here by 0.22%.

Nothing here gets decided by a comfortable margin — and right now, Trump’s
allies hold every state-level office in Pennsylvania except for Governor
and Lieutenant Governor.

So yes, Derek,
we’re one of the many, many campaigns in your inbox today. We’ll probably
be in it tomorrow, and I’m not going to pretend otherwise.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22128?t=1003&akid=881%2E245147%2E4_P6kf ]But whatever we close out with tomorrow at midnight is what funds these
last four days we have to reach undecided voters. Every one of those
emails you’re sorting through is a campaign trying to finish the way it
started — and this is the one where a point or two decides whether there’s
a single check left in this state on what Donald Trump wants to do to it.
So please,
Derek, pitch in any amount
before it’s too late.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
