* * *
All we've heard from Democrats for almost a decade at this point is: January 6th, January 6th, January 6th.
For years, Donald Trump's election-integrity agenda was defined by the bitter controversies and political grievances of 2020.
In large part, Democrats had successfully co-opted the issue.
Until now.
Heading into the midterms this week, the administration is finally mobilizing the federal government to enforce it aggressively.
To take just one example, look at the unprecedented blitz of criminal cases announced this month. On October 26, the DOJ **[announced charges against 48 noncitizens](https://substack.com/redirect/e12a9c17-6444-40a8-9fe5-0ab22a3ac2f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** across five states for alleged illegal voting and fraudulent registration.
[| | | | | U.S. Department of Justice
---
@TheJusticeDept
🗳️🚨 Today, the Justice Department announced charges involving 48 ALIENS in Pennsylvania, California, Florida, New York, and Nevada in connection with illegal voting, fraudulent voter registration, and related election crimes. The cases include voting by aliens in federal ...
| 2:06 PM * Oct 26, 2026 * 290K Views552 Replies * 2.91K Reposts * 8.04K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/1da117f2-9c84-40c9-8652-65bd466ba8fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
That major sweep followed a relentless wave of localized crackdowns: **[16 individuals charged on October 12](https://substack.com/redirect/cec856e6-5cde-4430-87ac-67c03005b957?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , a sweeping operation involving **[28 permanent residents](https://substack.com/redirect/dca2d73e-3b0d-4ed1-a8ad-3c2c69234fc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in California on October 19, and federal prosecutors demanding Washington state segregate **[over 400 potentially unlawful ballots](https://substack.com/redirect/5ce8d570-15d1-45b9-a374-656b6f649500?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. Yesterday, Wisconsin prosecutors charged two Canadian citizens with illegally voting in past federal elections.
Election fraud is real, and Trump is attacking it.
These are no longer abstract allegations debated on CNN. These are named defendants facing federal judges for violations in recent election cycles.
* * *
# PolitiBrawl will NOT stop fighting!
Our reporters were on the ground in **[the Paris riots last weekend](https://substack.com/redirect/6282acc3-c179-426b-8213-d579829fe7b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , the same ones the mainstream media told you were "mostly peaceful" and about student textbook costs.
If we are not careful and diligent, the streets of American cities will be next.
We are NOT messing around here - This is a war on information and **[we are at the front.](https://substack.com/redirect/4ba65f0a-6fac-4917-8cef-17bc44349f1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

That is our crusade and we are honored to have you with us as we embark in that endeavor.

Thank you for believing in us!
_The Politibrawl Team_

_**(Piece continues):**_
The administration is also crowdsourcing the crackdown. Just a week out from Election Day, Trump announced **[a $1 million reward](https://substack.com/redirect/d76a9ea7-539a-4aa0-a4af-ea29a2105f05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for information leading to the arrest and conviction of voter fraud. He even floated granting investigators like Nick Shirley 1% of the fraud that he found.
Backed by a new federal reporting portal, the administration is actively soliciting evidence from the public, attempting to turn voter concern into actionable intelligence.
Earlier this year, Trump signed Executive Order 14399, directing agencies like the Department of Homeland Security and the Social Security Administration to develop new data systems to verify voter citizenship. While that executive order is currently fighting through a maze of constitutional challenges in federal court, Republican-led states aren't waiting around for the results.
States like Wyoming have already enacted laws requiring strict documentary proof of citizenship for voter registration. According to recent tracking, eleven other states have pushed through similar legislative changes, fundamentally rewriting the rulebook at the local level.
The political landscape has fundamentally shifted, and it's a welcome change.
One of my largest criticisms of Trump after 2020 was that his rhetoric wasn't backed up by action. "They cheated." Yes we know, they're Democrats... They always cheat!
Winners don't complain, they act, which is exactly what Trump is now doing.

Friend, Election Day is only FOUR DAYS AWAY. While we’re busy hitting the pavement and talking to voters in this last stretch, we wanted to take a minute to say thank you. We’re grateful for all your support — from launch day, Primary Day, and now, Election Day, you’ve been in the trenches with us. In these final days, we’re leaving it all on the field. And we hope you will, too. So, ask that neighbor down the street if they have a plan to vote. Drop a few more pieces of our campaign literature around the neighborhood. Make a few more calls and make sure folks know just how high the stakes are in this election. We couldn’t have made it this far without you. Now help us bring it home. **Last Call to Get Involved**

clean_body: Let’s bring it home! | | = Friend, Election Day is only FOUR DAYS AWAY. While we’re busy hitting the pavement and talking to voters in this last stretch, we wanted to take a minute to say thank you. We’re grateful for all your support — from launch day, Primary Day, and now, Election Day, you’ve been in the trenches with us. In these final days, we’re leaving it all on the field. And we hope you will, too. So, ask that neighbor down the street if they have a plan to vote. Drop a few more pieces of our campaign literature around the neighborhood. Make a few more calls and make sure folks know just how high the stakes are in this election. We couldn’t have made it this far without you. Now help us bring it home. Last Call to Get Involved 1. Canvass, canvass, canvass. We’ll be out every day (including Election Day) getting folks to the polls. This is our last chance to tell voters why we deserve better than Dan Meuser — and we need to be LOUD! 2. Fill out this form to phone bank during the final few days of the election. Once you fill out this form, a member of our team will get in touch with you to get you set up to make calls whenever you'd like, wherever you'd like. 3. November 3, 7:30-10PM: — Join us for light bites and a cash bar at the Pottsville Zone while we wait for the results to come in! What We’ve Been Up To That’s what one man said to Rachel last week in Shamokin. He and his wife went to college, bought a house, and started their family. But the cost of day care and everything else has pushed them to the edge. Families shouldn’t have to go broke to raise their kids. Rachel is running to fix that. ** There’s no block party like a Lebanon block party! Great costumes, neighbors, and of course, Jenga. Rachel spent some time canvassing in Columbia County before hanging out with some awesome trick-or-treaters in Cressona. Help us bring this race home. Pottsville Halloween Parade: Rachel and the team had a great time handing out hot chocolate as the Pottsville Halloween Parade marched by! We loved seeing all the creative costumes and especially enjoyed watching the Pottsville High School Marching Band. Who are these data centers for? Because it doesn't feel like they're here for us. Shapiro Bus Stop: On Thursday, Governor Josh Shapiro made a stop in Schuylkill County, joining Rachel and local supporters for a rally! ** Last night in Pottsville, Rachel held her final town hall. We've been all over the district this month, holding seven town halls at our fire companies, in local theaters, and community centers. We’ve talked about AI data centers. The cost of home heating oil. How we can save Social Security. How to stop the corruption and fraud in Washington. How to hold health insurance companies accountable. But the thread through it all has been that our communities have been left behind. We don’t have anyone fighting for us in Washington. And at a time of real pain for our part of Pennsylvania, that needs to change. Because we deserve better. With less than one week to go, let’s give this one final push. We’ll see you on the other side! _**I 'll be straight with you: we're behind.**_
**A new poll has Susan Collins up half a point in this race. I 'd be lying if I said it didn't sting.**
Even worse, we're falling behind our final end-of-month fundraising goal. **[Will you chip in now to help me reach my final end-of-month goal before Election Day?->](https://substack.com/redirect/d8ba9e7d-4d70-46ee-9eda-d7125d116499?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

But their cash advantage isn't the end of things. This race will come down to the 6.5% of undecided Maine voters. Whoever reaches them wins. And if we don't win here in Maine, Democrats don't flip the Senate. It's that simple.
That's why my team set a goal of raising $2,000,000 before the end of the month. We need cash in these final days to reach the voters who will decide this election. This deadline is our final chance to turn the tide.
**[If you can, please chip in $10 or whatever you're able to today >>](https://substack.com/redirect/f1ca8be4-6fa9-4af5-bbbd-f924bd7538df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Troy

Security video from Lewiston City Hall reported exclusively by _The Robinson Report_ went viral on Friday (someone should tell the left-wing newspapers...), and now the U.S. Attorney for Maine is reviewing the video. We're maybe 20 percent of our way through the video, so stay tuned... But the question everyone is asking is: Will anyone be held accountable?
The obvious answer at the state level is no. Maine's institutions are far too corrupt and captured by the very political machine orchestrating the illicit electioneering that can be seen over and over again in the CCTV video. The group behind the vigorous electioneering in Lewiston City Hall is the Maine People's Alliance and, more specifically, the political project that blossomed out of the notorious Medicaid fraud operation at Gateway Community Services: the Community Organizing Alliance (COA).
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..kDlKDWGqG-SsEaf_Rj_AMapXegUZp6MNyNpQJeBr1Oo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=222844567)
COA was formed in 2022 immediately after Gateway received no-bid contracts from the Mills Administration to engage in "public health" work that was indiscernible from political canvassing and vote buying. After I exposed COA's taxpayer-funded political advocacy for the Democratic Party, the website mysteriously went dark, with the board member page landing in the trash bin. Fortunately I screen-capped it for posterity, so you can see that the board members of that migrant-centered political group were Abdullahi Ali, former Gateway CEO, and Fatuma Hussein, director of the Immigrant Resource Center of Maine, and a handful of Maine Democratic Party insiders, including ex-Troy Jackson chief of staff B.J. McCollister.
Safiya Khalid and her brother Mohamed Khalid, both employees of Ali's at Gateway, were the executive directors at the founding. As COA boasts on their public social media, the group worked hard to recruit migrants to vote for Democrats in 2022 and 2024 -- while Gateway, at exactly the same time, was getting paid to go door to door signing migrants up for welfare. Fast-forward to today: Gateway has sh*t the bed and Ali has fled U.S. law enforcement for his properties in Africa, but COA is still pulling strings at Lewiston City Hall, with Khalid playing a visible role in orchestrating the "translator" scheme that can be observed on the CCTV footage.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/af8c43dc-8767-4a82-a7a1-42d9f1937a4d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The reason I bring up the back history of COA is because COA's biggest advocate is none other than Maine Secretary of State Shenna Bellows. COA's Instagram page -- which for some mysterious reason has recently been [scrubbed from the Internet](https://substack.com/redirect/ef723e53-f934-46c8-839f-b67b563ade03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- was filled with pictures of Bellows glad-handing at various pro-Democrat events. Although Khalid and whoever is calling the shots at COA are trying to cover up their activities, plenty of photographs still exist (thanks to my archives) showing Bellows cozying up to the Democrat activist group. Like this photo of Bellows smiling with some COA staffers, as well as State Sen. Jill Duson (D-Cumberland) and her son, Nathan Davis, who recently received a battlefield promotion to run the sinking ship that is Gateway.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b2262df2-5e4f-4884-b5cd-ae96ed591552?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Because of this cozy relationship, and because of COA's overt role in directing the illicit electioneering that can be observed on the CCTV video, Bellows is far too conflicted to even speak about how the Secretary of State's office might handle such brazen and recidivist violations of election laws. But even if she was not joined at the hip to the Maine People's Alliance and its various spawn, no one really thinks she'd lift a finger to do anything other than, perhaps, try to throw me and Jon Fetherston in jail. The same goes for Gov. Janet Mills (D) and Attorney General Aaron Frey (D).
In a theoretical world where Maine was a serious state with leaders of integrity, State Rep. Scott Harriman, the DSA Democrat agitators who raided the State House, and all of the Somali translators who habitually violated the law could be looking at Class E misdemeanors. Interpreters who use their position beside a voter to steer that person's ballot choices could face criminal charges under Maine law, with misdemeanor penalties reaching six months in jail and a $1,000 fine for each proven offense.
Alas, Maine is not a serious state; Maine is a corrupt banana republic run by kleptocratic, power-hungry weirdos whose moral compass points only toward what will make them wealthier or give them more power to order people around. So whatever justice might be meted out for this clear attempt to unfairly influence Maine's elections will have to come from the federal level.
On that note, U.S. Attorney for Maine Andrew Benson told _The Robinson Report_ on Friday that the Justice Department is reviewing the CCTV footage, the implication being that federal prosecutors are looking for potential federal crimes.
"We review all evidence concerning complaints of voter intimidation and election interference," Benson told The Robinson Report, specifically including the Lewiston early-voting video in his statement.
Federal prosecutors have tools available if the evidence meets their requirements. Federal voter-intimidation law carries up to one year in prison. As one Republican candidate observed at city hall during the Harriman Hate March, at least one elderly couple were intimidated by the overt display of militant progressivism that stormed through the voting area this week. Knowingly and willfully procuring or casting materially fraudulent ballots in a federal election can carry up to five years. Would a ballot filled out by an interpreter rather than a voter qualify as a fraudulent ballot? I'd say so.
Then there's the conspiracy angle. A conspiracy to deprive people of federally protected rights can carry up to 10 years under the ordinary penalty provision. One could easily argue that an organized campaign to effectively stuff the ballot box with fraudulent votes cancels out the votes of legitimate voters and therefore deprives them of the franchise. Further, to the extent government officials observed this conspiracy in action and did nothing to protect the voting rights of Americans, the denial of rights case starts to take shape.
The big kahuna, though, would be votes cast by ineligible noncitizens. Of course, merely needing a translator doesn't mean you're an illegal voter. It's possible that a Somali refugee could have come to Maine, spent 20 years not learning English, then applied for naturalization using one of the exemptions that allows foreigners to become U.S. citizens without speaking English. Sure, it's possible. But on the off chance that any of the hundreds of individuals who required a translator -- and in some cases multiple translators -- are not U.S. citizens, the federal criminal investigation gets a lot more exciting.

They are far-right extremists who are on the verge of taking over our state government. [**David Crowley and I are running to make Wisconsin work for families, not for billionaires. But to make that vision a reality, we need your help. I’ve been told that my dream for Wisconsin isn’t feasible, that making life better for working people isn’t a winning message. **But, Derek, that’s a lie.**
**I know that we can build a Wisconsin** where parents don’t have to choose between childcare and their mortgage payment.
**I know that we can build a Wisconsin** where women have freedom over their own bodies.
**And I know that we can build a Wisconsin** where our children can grow up with opportunities, workers are protected, and seniors can retire without worry.
**This isn’t a pipe dream, Derek; it can be our reality. But if Tiffany and Varnam win, this vision for a better Wisconsin will be flushed down the drain.**
Derek, David Crowley and I need your help to fight back against the far-right billionaires backing Tiffany and Varnam.

Peter, **A new poll just came out showing me ahead of Greg Abbott, 47% to 45%.** That’s six polls in the last month to show us leading this race. Not tied. Ahead. If you’d told me a year ago, when we launched this campaign, that we’d be here, I’m not sure I would have believed you. But here we are, and it’s because of people like you. My name ID has jumped to 79% in just the last few weeks, and I’m still viewed favorably by a 12-point margin (45% to 33%), even after Abbott has spent millions attacking me. Grassroots donations from supporters like you made that possible. body:
#
Peter,
**Today is the last day of early voting in Texas, Arizona, and Georgia, and the numbers coming in are unlike anything we’ve seen.**
→**5.5 million** Latinos have voted already — and**750,000 Latinos under the age of 30** have voted, the highest number in a midterm early vote.
→ In Texas, 1.7 million Latinos have voted and make up 28.5% of the Texas electorate,**the highest share ever for Latinos.**
→ In Georgia, more than 2.3 million people have voted early, and new voters are favoring Democrats 52% to 12%, a huge jump from 2022.
That didn’t just _happen_ — it happened because we spent months knocking doors, sending texts, and making sure young and first-time Latino voters know exactly where, when, and how to vote, and what’s on the line.
**These numbers prove our voter mobilization work is paying off — but we still have 4 more days to go.** [**Will you chip in $3 right now to help us keep it going through Election Day?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261030-2.hxH-ga&amount=3&refcode=em20261030-738&t=1&akid=738%2E1366028%2E9Bom7U)
From today until polls close on Tuesday, November 3rd, we have to reach every last voter who hasn’t cast their ballot yet. Races like James Talarico’s and Jon Ossoff’s will be close, and the voters we reach will decide who wins.

| **Hi Friends!**

Don’t leave your vote to chance! **Tomorrow, Saturday, October 31, is the final day of early voting. **If you haven’t voted, make tomorrow the day—and bring a friend or family member with you!

A stronger America starts with us showing up. We’re fighting to defend our freedoms, protect our values, and put America First. But none of that happens if we don’t turn out and vote. We need every vote, including yours!

Then, after we’ve given this election everything we’ve got, join Beth and me on Election Night as we watch the results and hopefully celebrate victory together!

**Tuesday, November 3
Doors open at 7:00 PM
Rolling Hills Country Club

Thank you for standing with us. Let’s make this final day of early voting count and finish strong!
